The '''Advanced Product Research Sector''' was a district in the [[Labor Valley]] region of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] capital [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. [[Corellian Industries]] maintained a [[Corellian Industries factory|factory]] and a [[Corellian Industries lab|laboratory]] in the region, though both were captured by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]]. A [[Corellian munitions factory|munitions factory]] in the area was also damaged during the battle.
